summary: The PR addresses an issue where an empty __all__ attribute is ignored, but the fix may not cover all cases and could introduce behavioral changes.

issues.description: The fix checks if self.__all__ is None, but it should also handle the case where self.__all__ is an empty list. The current fix does not address the original issue fully.
Changing the condition from 'if not self.__all__:' to 'if self.__all__ is None:' could lead to behavioral regression, as it might not correctly handle modules without an __all__ attribute.
